documents.title: Evidence Register
documents.description: Every update creates a new immutable version. Only one primary FIR and one primary chargesheet per case - further uploads of either become new versions.
documents.ariaScroll: Evidence register, scroll for all columns
documents.emptyDescription: Upload a PDF or supported image to create version 1.
documents.versionWarning: This case already has a primary {{type}} - "{{title}}" (v{{version}}). Check this to add your file as a new version of it. The previous version stays stored and viewable in its version history - nothing is deleted.
documents.alreadyPrimaryError: This case already has a primary {{type}} ("{{title}}"). Check the box to add this as a new version, or change the document type if this is genuinely different evidence.
documents.newVersionRegistered: New version of "{{title}}" registered - previous version stays available in its history.
documents.conflictRetry: {{message}} Check the "add as new version" box above and try again.

collaborators.title: Case Access & Assigned Personnel

timeline.title: Evidence Timeline & Contradiction Review
timeline.description: Finds people who can't have been where evidence says, at the same time, given travel time between locations.
timeline.noValidSchedule: No valid schedule reconciles these statements, even letting each stated window shift freely, given known travel time between the locations involved:
timeline.emptyDescription: Scan documents for candidates, add a statement manually, or both - conflicts appear here automatically once two statements about the same person can't both be true.
timeline.locationPlaceholder: City / place name, exact spelling matters
timeline.sourcePlaceholder: Quote or reference from the statement
timeline.candidatesFound: {{count}} candidate statement(s) found from uploaded documents - review below.
timeline.noCandidatesFound: No new candidates found. Confirm entities on your documents first, or add a statement manually.
timeline.confirmedContradiction: Confirmed - this creates a contradiction, see Open conflicts below.
timeline.contradictionDetected: Contradiction detected for {{person}} - see Open conflicts below.
